title: Relationship Type Vocabulary
description: Controlled vocabulary for all semantic edge relationship types. Every type used in an edge must be defined here. No undeclared types accepted.

TEMPORALLY_PRECEDES.description: Source technique is commonly observed temporally before target technique in the same intrusion.
TEMPORALLY_PRECEDES.example: T1059.001 TEMPORALLY_PRECEDES T1003 in Azure AD intrusions

CAUSALLY_ENABLES.description: Source technique creates a capability or condition that makes the target technique possible or more effective.
CAUSALLY_ENABLES.example: T1078 CAUSALLY_ENABLES T1021 — valid accounts enable remote services

LOGICALLY_REQUIRES.description: Source technique cannot execute without the target having occurred first. Hard prerequisite — stronger than CAUSALLY_ENABLES.
LOGICALLY_REQUIRES.example: T1550.001 LOGICALLY_REQUIRES T1003 — Pass the Hash requires prior credential dumping

LIKELY_FOLLOWED_BY.description: Probabilistic successor. Statistically common but without strict temporal or causal dependency. Weaker than TEMPORALLY_PRECEDES.

DETECTED_BY.description: Source technique generates telemetry detected by the target detection rule or data source.
DETECTED_BY.note: Must include coverage_state and any conditions (licensing, config, browser) as edge attributes.

MITIGATED_BY.description: Source technique is reduced in effectiveness or prevented by the target mitigation.

ATTRIBUTED_TO.description: Source entity is attributed to the target threat actor group with a given confidence.

RELATED_TO.description: Undirected semantic similarity. Use only when no more specific type applies. Use sparingly.
RELATED_TO.note: Catch-all. If used frequently, propose a new specific type instead.

DELIVERS.description: Source entity delivers the target software payload.

EXPLOITS.description: Source technique or software exploits a specific vulnerability or weakness.

DROPS.description: Source software drops or installs the target software on a compromised system.

COMMUNICATES_WITH.description: Source software communicates with target infrastructure or software for C2, exfiltration, or coordination.

semantic_categories.procedural_sequence: Temporal or probabilistic ordering of attacker actions.
semantic_categories.causal_dependency: Capability or prerequisite dependencies between techniques.
semantic_categories.detection_coverage: Relationships between techniques and the detections that cover them.
semantic_categories.mitigation_coverage: Relationships between techniques and controls that reduce effectiveness.
semantic_categories.attribution: Links between behaviors and threat actor groups.
semantic_categories.malware_behavior: Malware delivery, execution, and C2 behavior.
semantic_categories.lateral_movement_path: Attacker traversal between systems or identity boundaries.
semantic_categories.semantic_similarity: Weak associative relationships without causal or temporal structure.

confidence_methods.analyst_validated: Score assigned by a human analyst after reviewing evidence.
confidence_methods.peer_reviewed: Score reviewed and confirmed by a second analyst.
confidence_methods.ml_inferred: Score generated by ML model. Requires human review before approval.
confidence_methods.co_occurrence_stats: Score derived from statistical co-occurrence across a dataset.
confidence_methods.expert_elicitation: Score derived from structured expert judgment.
confidence_methods.automated_correlation: Score derived from automated graph correlation. Lower trust.
